findings.evidence: MellinWeight.lean:131 `theorem integrableOn_rpow_neg_one_sub`, :143 `theorem integrableOn_rpow_mul_log`, :174 `theorem integrableOn_rpow_mul_log_log` are all public; the PR's statements mention only ℝ, rpow, log and exp.
findings.fix: Move `integrableOn_rpow_mul_one_add_log_sq` and `one_add_log_sq_le` into TauCeti/Analysis/SpecialFunctions/Integrals/MellinWeight.lean as public lemmas. Make `rpow_neg_mul_log_div` public there too, or in a general real-power/log file.
findings.issue: `integrableOn_rpow_mul_one_add_log_sq` is `private` but only involves Mathlib's real numbers and does not depend on prime sums. The same kind of lemma (`integrableOn_rpow_mul_log`, `integrableOn_rpow_mul_log_log`) is public in MellinWeight.lean. The same problem applies to `one_add_log_sq_le` (line ~239) and `rpow_neg_mul_log_div` (line ~207).

findings.evidence: Statement: `weightedPrimeSum a n = ∑ p ∈ Nat.primesLE n, (log p / p) • a p`. The right side is the definition body with `⌊↑n⌋₊` simplified, so this is an unfold lemma rather than a normal-form lemma.
findings.fix: Remove `@[simp]` from `weightedPrimeSum_natCast` and keep it as an ordinary rewrite lemma. If automation on floors is wanted, tag `weightedPrimeSum_natFloor` `@[simp]` instead.
findings.issue: `@[simp] weightedPrimeSum_natCast` rewrites `weightedPrimeSum a ↑n` into the raw sum over `Nat.primesLE n`, so `simp` unfolds the sum at every natural-number argument. This breaks the statements of `tendsto_rpow_neg_smul_weightedPrimeSum`, `smul_intervalIntegral_weightedPrimeSum` and `weightedPrimeSum_natCast_succ` for consumers, and means `weightedPrimeSum_natFloor` can never be a usable simp lemma.

summary: Three lemmas that only involve Mathlib's real numbers are hidden as `private` instead of being made public in `MellinWeight.lean`, next to the matching public `integrableOn_rpow_mul_log*` lemmas. `weightedPrimeSum_natCast` is `@[simp]` but unfolds the new definition, so `weightedPrimeSum a n` gets opened up whenever `simp` runs.
